<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="geofence_guard"><subtree><Retry num_attempts="3">
  <Sequence>
    <WaitSimTime duration_s="{wait_time}" />
    <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{recovery_speed}" timeout_s="{recovery_timeout}" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
  </Sequence>
</Retry></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="wait_time" min="1" max="30" initial="5" /><port name="recovery_speed" min="1" max="6" initial="4" /><port name="recovery_timeout" min="10" max="120" initial="40" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Wrap the geofence guard in a Fallback. If the drone is blown outside the geofence, it will wait for the wind gust to subside and then fly towards the required goal to re-enter the geofence. Once inside, the guard will succeed and normal mission execution will resume.</rationale></patch>

<patch operator="WrapFallback" anchor="guarded_flight"><subtree><ReactiveSequence>
  <IsBatteryOk min_pct="{min_batt}" />
  <IsInsideGeofence margin_m="0" />
  <Sequence>
    <ForceSuccess>
      <GoToRequiredGoal velocity="{speed}" timeout_s="{timeout}" arrive_tol_m="1.5" />
    </ForceSuccess>
    <ReturnToLaunch timeout_s="120" velocity="{speed}" arrive_tol_m="2.0" />
    <Land timeout_s="60" />
  </Sequence>
</ReactiveSequence></subtree><tunable_ports><port name="min_batt" min="10" max="20" initial="15" /><port name="speed" min="2" max="6" initial="4" /><port name="timeout" min="20" max="120" initial="60" /></tunable_ports><rationale>Wrap the guarded flight in a Fallback. If the conservative battery guard fails, the recovery sequence uses a lower battery threshold to complete the required goal, skips optional goals, and then returns to launch and lands, while maintaining geofence and lower battery guards.</rationale></patch>
